question: Which of the following is example of White Goods?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Air Conditioners and LED Lights.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **White Goods** refer to** large electrical appliances used domestically**, such as refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners.
 
• Air Conditioners are a common example of white goods as they are large household appliances.
 
• LED Lights can also be considered white goods in the context of home appliances and electronics.
 
• These goods are typically durable and used for household purposes.
